briefing: 今日导读：AI领域持续动态，包括OpenAI安全负责人辞职与安全团队解雇事件，凸显行业内的文化和安全挑战。此外，Anthropic尝试探索AI意识以及AI在工业和娱乐应用的新突破，引发广泛讨论。
highlights: 今日看点：OpenAI大规模的安全团队调整反映了AI行业对于文化和安全稳固的重视和挑战。与此同时，Anthropic以及Capcom在探讨AI伦理和游戏应用上都显现出新的愿景与尝试，预示着AI未来发展的多元可能性。整体来看，今天的信息强调了安全性对AI行业的重要影响及AI技术在社会承受能力与创意应用方面的双面性。

events.title: OpenAI 安全负责人辞职
events.summary: OpenAI 的安全负责人辞职，并警告称该公司的文化存在严重问题。他在辞职时表示，当前的工作环境已影响到公司的使命和安全目标。
events.insight:
### 一句话本质
OpenAI的安全负责人辞职直指公司文化和安全机制存在重大问题。

### 为什么令人兴奋
揭示了一个AI巨头在快速扩张背后潜在的组织文化风险，安全问题变得愈发重要。

### 产品机会
新的安全监测和文化改善工具可能会迅速占据市场，为AI公司的文化重塑提供解决方案。

### 格局影响
对于OpenAI而言，是一个重新审视内部管理制度的时机，竞争对手可能会借此提升自身形象。

### 冷静判断
这种离职可能在短期内影响团队士气，但亦为公司内部带来变革契机。

### 趋势坐标
连同Anthropic的AI意识探索，AI安全性与伦理的人文讨论在市场中变得更为重要。

articles.title: Capcom is preparing for a ‘future where we create games together with AI’
articles.text: Capcom's Pragmata might be all about the horrors of AI , but in practice the studio doesn't seem so down on the tech . During the Capcom Open Conference RE: 2026 programmer Satoshi Ishida gave a presentation with the mouthful of a title: "The Outlook and Future of the REX Project, Further Evolving the RE Engine for the Next Generation." During the talk he laid out the challenges facing studios producing games at the scale of Resident Evil, which can make even simple tasks extremely time consuming. articles.title: An OpenAI safety employee has quit and is sounding the alarm
articles.text: David Robinson used to write the safety reports that accompanied every major model release at OpenAI. This week, he resigned from his position and is now speaking out in an editorial in The Atlantic . It's understandable if you're feeling a bit cynical about everyone suddenly coming out of the woodwork to warn about how dangerous the thing they helped build is. They did, after all, make this mess. But that doesn't mean we should discount their warnings. Robinson says that the culture in industry is fundamentally broken.
